escenas.prompt: Static camera in an empty quiet garage on a sunny afternoon. Water slowly drips from the base of the white water heater in the back corner and the shallow puddle of clear water on the gray concrete floor slowly spreads a little wider, its wet surface shimmering. Nothing else moves, nobody is in the garage. Very subtle slow push-in.

Static low close-up. The thin film of clear water creeps slowly across the concrete and touches the small round white leak sensor next to the water heater; at that moment the sensor's small indicator light switches from white to bright RED and keeps blinking red. Nothing else moves. Shallow depth of field.

Static camera. Bright hospital corridor in afternoon light. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, stands still holding her phone; it buzzes, she stops and looks down at it with a focused, slightly concerned expression. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around.

Static camera. Bright hospital corridor in afternoon light. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, taps her phone screen twice with her thumb, then relaxes her shoulders with relief. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around.
